cns.text: Selvala is the elven ranger who, in a flashback, worked inseparably with Brago to build a coalition and draft the Charter that forged Paliano, and who agreed with him, reluctantly, to the priests' magical preservation treatments when he was diagnosed with an incurable illness.

At a private dinner she tells the withered king that he is no longer the king she remembers and that she begged him to refuse the Custodi's treatments, and she accuses him of valuing his own life above those he served.
Brago reveals that there will be no more treatments and begs her to kill him, and Selvala forgives him and stabs him through the heart, and his body crumbles to dust.
